:''If you were looking for Salvadore, one of Brock's younger brothers, see [[Brock's siblings]].'' ---- [[File:Salvador.png|thumb|250px|Salvador]] '''Salvador''' (Japanese: '''サブロウ''' ''Saburō'') is a [[character of the day]] and a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Cherrygrove City]]. Salvador appeared in ''[[EP266|A Claim to Flame!]]'', as {{Ash}}'s first opponent during the Screening Round of the [[Silver Conference]]. The computer randomly selected Ash to go first, and Salvador sent out his {{p|Furret}} to {{pkmn|battle}} [[Ash's Pikachu]]. Furret turned out to be a tough opponent, though Ash ultimately won and advanced onto the next stages. It is not known if Salvador won his other two battles in the Screening Round, and therefore it is not known if he moved on in the Silver Conference. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Salvador's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Slavador |pkmn=Furret |type1=Normal |epnum=EP266 |epname=A Claim to Flame! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Tara Jayne |img=Salvador Furret.png |desc={{p|Furret}} is Salvador's main powerhouse. Salvador used his Furret against [[Ash's Pikachu]] in a [[Silver Conference]] {{pkmn|battle}}. Furret turned out to be a formidable opponent. It dodged Pikachu's attacks with its speed, and it confused the {{type|Electric}} Pokémon by repeatedly using Dig. {{Ash}} finally commanded Pikachu to grab onto Furret's back, where he used {{m|Thunderbolt}} underground to defeat Furret and give Ash the victory. Furret's known moves are {{m|Double Team}}, {{m|Swift}}, {{m|Dig}}, and {{m|Headbutt}}.}} ==Achievements== ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Salvador has obtained in the [[Johto]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[EP266|A Claim to Flame!]]'') ===Pokémon League=== Salvador has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Silver Conference]] - {{tt|Unknown|This Trainer lost one battle of three but could still have proceeded by winning the other two}} (''[[EP266|A Claim to Flame!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color dark}} |ja=岸尾大輔 ''[[Daisuke Kishio]]'' |en=[[Pete Zarustica]] |fi=Karolina Blom |no=Christian Barmen |pl=Ireneusz Machnicki |es_eu=Ricardo Escobar |es_la=Gabriel Ortiz
